text:
It’s the first of two consecutive games between these two sides, who will reunite at San Siro next Tuesday for the Coppa Italia Round of 16.
Inter must cope without the injured Alessandro Bastoni, Hakan Calhanoglu and Ange-Yoan Bonny. Piotr Zielinski is back in action, but not fit enough to start, according to several sources, including Gazzetta and Sky.
Inter’s second-choice goalkeeper Ivan Provedel will start in goal, letting Josep Martinez rest. Carlos Augusto will replace the injured Bastoni in central defence.
Lautaro Martinez is expected to return to the Nerazzurri XI, joining either Francesco Pio Esposito or Marcus Thuram, though the Frenchman is the favourite.
Sebastian Otoa will replace Ostigard in Genoa’s central defence, joining Johan Vásquez and Alessandro Marcandalli. The latter spoke about this game, among other things, in an exclusive interview with Football Italia on Friday.
Inter vs. Genoa – where to watch on TV
The match is available on DAZN in the UK and Ireland and on Paramount+ in the USA. Football Italia will provide live updates via a live blog.
Inter vs. Genoa – probable line-ups
Inter (3-5-2): Provedel; Bisseck, Akanji, Carlos Augusto; Diouf, Barella, Sucic, Jones, Dimarco; P. Esposito, Lautaro Martínez.
Genoa (3-4-2-1): Bijlow; Marcandalli, Otoa, Vásquez; Ehizibue, Wiafe, Traorè, Mitaj; Ellertsson, Messias; Osmajic.
